parameters.query: WITH b AS (UPDATE soins.brouillons SET statut = 'valide' WHERE id = $1::uuid AND statut = 'brouillon' RETURNING *) INSERT INTO soins.validations (patient_id, mode, action, consigne, texte, sources, modifiee, valide_par, soignant_id, brouillon_id) SELECT b.patient_id, b.mode, b.action, b.consigne, $2::text, (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT f->>'label'), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.faits) AS f), btrim($2::text) <> btrim(b.texte_ia), $3::text, NULLIF($4::text, ''), b.id FROM b RETURNING id AS validation_id, patient_id, mode, action, modifiee
